---
title: "F-secmsg — End-to-end secure messaging"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 3
---

*F-secmsg* (End-to-end secure messaging) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Introduced as part of a single decomposition of the Signal protocol into this functionality, a continuous-key-exchange functionality (*F-CKE*), epoch-level symmetric ratchets, and a forward-secure AEAD functionality (*F-fsAEAD*).

*References:*

- Canetti et al. [*Universally composable end-to-end secure messaging*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2022/376). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2022, volume 13508 of LNCS, 2022.
